_comment: Binding coverage configuration. Source of truth: public methods on the core
rusty-llama handle types (Model, Context, Sequence). The checker compares them
against the symbols actually exposed by the Elixir (Rustler) and Node (NAPI-RS)
Two buckets let CI stay green while still catching drift:
ignore - intentionally never bound (raw pointers, generics, raw C enums).
These are excluded from the core surface entirely.
todo   - known-missing bindings we intend to add. Reported as a warning,
but do NOT fail CI. Move an entry out once it's bound.
The check FAILS only on a method that is in core, not ignored, not in todo, and
not bound in a given language (new, untracked drift), or on a stale binding
symbol that no longer exists in core.

ignore.Context::sample: generic over LlamaSampler; sampler API is not bound
ignore.Sequence::sample: generic over LlamaSampler; sampler API is not bound
